messages.subject: knitr in Lyx
parts:

In RStudio, knitr works very well for compiling HTML.   That does not seem to be the case for compiling to a PDF.  Could anyone please suggest pathways to using knitr in Lyx, which I already have installed?  Could you also please direct me to easy-to-follow resources on knitr in Lyx?

Thanks in advance,

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] knitr in Lyx
parts:
Did you watch the video on this page at all?
http://yihui.name/knitr/demo/lyx/ The answer was given in the first 5
seconds.

If you are a LyX or LaTeX beginner, it is not recommended to start
using knitr there (there is a lot to learn about LaTeX before you can
use LyX comfortably). You'd better start from Rnw source documents to
understand how things work at the lowest level, then move up
gradually.

Regards,
Yihui
